description: Answer 'why did we decide this?' from searchable organizational history, with dissent and outcomes.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined. If ../../shared/kit.js loads, it takes precedence.

notes.note: Institutional knowledge walking out the door is a real, expensive problem. But the product requires people to write down decisions and dissent — the behavior change IS the product, and it's the part nobody does. At $8/user/mo this is a Notion feature competing with Notion. Already scored low; it earned it.
Archive search returns results; Log-a-decision opens; zero errors.

notes.change: Added decision review reminders: review-due badges, KPI, and record-outcome flow persisted per decision.
